root_cause: A NetworkPolicy applied during this morning's security hardening is dropping traffic from the ingress controller to the storefront pods, so requests never reach the backend and nginx returns 502 for /shop.
evidence: ingress-nginx error log shows upstream connection failures for the /shop path
storefront pods are Running and Ready, so the pods themselves look healthy
fix: Add an ingress rule to the NetworkPolicy allowing traffic from the ingress-nginx namespace to the storefront pods.
